responsibility: Implements the small complexity metric used to bound growth of analyzer symbolic values and regions. It computes node-count and depth measures for new objects built from existing regions, svalues, or vectors of svalues, providing the arithmetic that region_model_manager uses to reject excessively deep symbolic structures before they explode analysis cost.
same_name_distinction: Implements the arithmetic for computing complexity values from regions, svalues, pairs, and vectors, whereas complexity.h only defines the metric type and its constructor/function declarations.
